blocks.text: Introduction: Before Saul had his first encounter with God on the way to Damascus, he was an avowed enemy of the Lord Jesus Christ. But after the experience on the way to Damascus, he became a different person. He was commissioned and he started preaching the same Gospel he had persecuted. {{act 9:1,act 9:2,act 9:3,act 9:4,act 9:5,act 9:6,act 9:7,act 9:8,act 9:9,act 9:10,act 9:11,act 9:12,act 9:13,act 9:14,act 9:15,act 9:16,act 9:17,act 9:18,act 9:19,act 9:20,act 9:21,act 9:22|Acts 9: 1-22}}. Saul (later Paul) was a servant or slave of the Law, culture and traditions but was turned to a servant of God in righteousness. Now that you have, by the Grace of God become a child of God, you must now learn to live and operate successfully in your new position. This is necessary because the kind of life you were living before is a sharp contrast to your new life.

1. You were a servant of sin, a child of the devil that now has been delivered from sin and its passions. {{rm 6:16,rm 6:17,rm 6:18|Rom 6: 16-18}}; {{rm 7:5,rm 7:6|Rom 7: 5-6}}; Jn. 8: 24, 44; {{1jo 3:8|I Jn. 3:8}}.

items: How does God see you now?

A new person entirely, whose sins have both been washed away and forgotten. II Cor. 5: 17; {{gl 6:15|Gal. 6: 15}}; {{hb 8:12|Heb 8: 12}}; {{re 1:5|Rev 1: 5}}; {{1jo 1:7|I John 1: 7}}; Is 43: 25; Is 44: 22. Sins mentioned here include every manner of sin committed in the past.

blocks.text: 3. The Immediate Things God Expects From You

1. 2. Break all diplomatic relations with the devil and his kingdom. I Cor 3: 16-17; {{rm 12:1,rm 12:2|Rom 12: 1-2}}; (Discuss) I Pet 2: 11; {{jm 4:7|James 4: 7}}; {{jo 17:17|John 17: 17}}. How can these be achieved? {{ps 119:11|Ps 119: 11}} Thy word has I hid in my heart that I might not sin against thee. 4. Have regular fellowship and unbroken personal relationship with God. items: The world will hate you. Discuss why? {{jo 15:18,jo 15:19|John 15: 18-19}}; {{jo 17:14|John 17: 14}}; Man 5: 44-48
